ov: كونان البربري (الإنجليزية: Conan the Barbarian) هو فيلم مغامرة تم إنتاجه في بلغاريا والولايات المتحدة وصدر في سنة 2011. من بطولة جايسون موموا وراشيل نيكولز وروز مكغوان وسعيد التغماوي ورون بيرلمان.
plotEn:
Born on a battlefield, Conan is the son of Corin, a barbarian chieftain and blacksmith. As a child, he proves himself a skilled but violent warrior to his father. One day, Conan's village is attacked by Khalar Zym, a warlord who seeks to restore the Mask of Acheron and resurrect his wife Maliva, an evil sorceress who will grant him dominion over Hyboria. The mask, crafted by sorcerers and used to subjugate the world, was broken into pieces and scattered among the barbarian tribes who overthrew them. After locating Corin's tribe's piece and slaughtering the entire village, Zym leaves Conan the only survivor.
Years later, a now-adult Conan is a swordsman and pirate, vowing revenge on Zym for his father's death. In the city of Messantia, he meets Ela-Shan, a thief being pursued by Lucius, one of Zym's soldiers whom Conan recognizes from his village's slaughter. He allows himself to be captured alongside Ela-Shan to confront Lucius. Torturing him, Conan learns that Zym needs only the last living female pureblood descendant of the sorcerers of Acheron to unleash the mask's power. Conan frees Lucius' prisoners and leaves them to kill him.
Zym and his daughter Marique attack a monastery in search of their quarry. Fassir, a monk, tells his student Tamara to flee, knowing she is whom Zym seeks. Conan rescues Tamara and captures Zym's righthand man, Remo. After learning Tamara's identity, Conan catapults Remo into Zym's camp, killing him and sending Zym a message.
